questions.text: How does UAP Document 301 define a performance bond?

options.text: Security furnished by the contractor and surety to guarantee execution of the work according to the contract
A bond that releases all liens after final payment
An invitation to make bidder proposals
A policy for a consulting architect's malpractice coverage

questions.rationale: Correct because it follows UAP Document 301 lines 488-492. The other options change the document, party, timing, amount, or legal effect stated in the checked local source.
questions.explanation: Confuses pricing dissatisfaction with performance default; high bids are not grounds for bond call. Budget changes by Owner are not contractor defaults; they do not justify bond call. Design changes are Owner-initiated, not contractor defaults; they do not justify bond call. Legitimate grounds for bond call are material breaches: failure to start work timely, unauthorized work suspension, failure to maintain schedule, or project abandonment. Bond call requires material breach: failure to start, unauthorized suspension, or abandonment.
